scope: github.com: one pull request; read-only checks, reviews and branch-rule observations

findings.explanation: A 40-character hexadecimal head commit was observed at collection start.
The relevant base reference and 40-character hexadecimal commit were observed.
The final PR read changed or could not establish the initial head, base and mergeability facts; collect again.
Required check names were read from GitHub policy sources.
Active branch rules were read (this collector evaluates check and review requirements only).
GitHub's review decision, or a fully read zero-approval rule, establishes the review requirement.
Observed required check `ci / integration` has a passing conclusion.

limitations: Human release decision required; this pack does not prove compliance or authorize a release.
No repository code, PR body, diff, private file content, artifact payload or access token is included.
GitHub rules are not fully reimplemented: deployment, merge-queue, app-bound check identity, signatures, bypass permissions and custom rules require separate review.
API sources are collected sequentially; facts may change during collection or immediately afterward. A matching head does not prove freshness.
No authenticated caller identity or host audit ID is established by this brick; the host may correlate its audit separately.

freshness.revalidation: Recollect when head/base, checks, reviews, rules or authorization may have changed; no fixed validity period is asserted.
